title: Structured eigenbases and pair state transfer on threshold graphs
summary: Recently, Macharete, Del-Vecchio, Teixeira and de Lima showed that a star and any threshold graph on the same number of vertices share the same eigenbasis relative to the Laplacian matrix. We use this fact to establish two main results in this paper. The first one is a characterization of threshold graphs that are \textit{simply structured}, i.e., their associated Laplacian matrices have eigenbases consisting of vectors with entries from the set $\{-1,0,1\}$.
